approval_source.question_set: E05-c: production SLH-DSA parameter set for custodian keys

decisions.question: D11-Q03
decisions.rule: Production root, emergency and upgrade custodian keys use SLH-DSA-SHAKE-256s, the parameter set the node's root verifier implements: 64-byte public keys and 29,792-byte signatures. Three hex-encoded signatures take 178,752 bytes, inside the node's 262,144-byte transaction bound.
